newsitem.title: ITALY: Prodi says Italy 1996 deficit to be below 140 trln.
newsitem.headline: Prodi says Italy 1996 deficit to be below 140 trln.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Wednesday Italy's budget deficit would be below 140 trillion lire at the end of 1996.
Prodi, answering questions in a hearing of the upper house foreign affairs committee, said: "We will not reach 140 trillion at the year end."
The government's official budget deficit target for this year was 123 trillion lire but senior government figures have recently said a figure of 130 trillion was more likely.
The official January-November cumulative PSBR was 135.3 trillion lire and Italian newspapers have speculated the year's total could come to around 140 trillion.
